name: speculateai
description: Invoke with @SpeculateAI, with or without extra text. Uses only the current chat to find the idea, assume it succeeds, trace second- and third-order effects, and identify the worst plausible downstream scenario.

interface.longDescription: When the user includes @SpeculateAI, use the current conversation to identify the idea, even if the user provides no additional text. Assume the idea succeeds, trace plausible second- and third-order consequences, identify the worst plausible downstream scenario without exaggeration, explain the causal chain, and ask one sharp question. Use only the current chat. No recommendations or solutions.
